verifications.claim: The 2026 NHL playoffs are scheduled to begin on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Saturday, April 18'; R2: 'Sat Apr 18'; R3: 'Dates April 18 – June 21, 2026'; R4: 'postseason begins on April 18'; R5: 'Saturday, April 18'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the playoffs begin on April 18, 2026, with several specifying Saturday.

verifications.claim: The 2026 NHL regular season concludes on April 16, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Thursday, April 16, with six games'; R4: 'The NHL regular season is scheduled to end on Thursday, April 16, with six games'
verifications.reasoning: References directly confirm the regular season ends on April 16, 2026.

verifications.claim: The 2026 NHL playoffs conclude no later than June 21, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the last possible day for it is June 21, per the NHL'; R3: 'will conclude with the Stanley Cup Final with the series ending no later than June 21'
verifications.reasoning: References explicitly state the playoffs or Stanley Cup Final ends no later than June 21, 2026.

verifications.claim: 2026 NHL playoff games will be broadcast on ESPN, NHL on TNT, Sportsnet, and TVA Sports.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'ESPN-produced telecasts (either on ESPN, ABC, or ESPN2) and TNT Sports-produced telecasts (either on TNT or TBS'; 'Sportsnet networks and CBC under the Hockey Night in Canada brand'
verifications.reasoning: R3 supports ESPN, TNT Sports (NHL on TNT), and Sportsnet as broadcasters for playoffs, but mentions CBC instead of TVA Sports and does not list all exactly.

verifications.claim: As of April 13, 2026, teams including the Hurricanes, Sabres, Canadiens, Lightning, Penguins, Senators, Bruins, Avalanche, Stars, Wild, Mammoth, Oilers, and Golden Knights have secured playoff spots.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'As of 11 a.m. on Monday, April 13 ... Carolina Hurricanes, Buffalo Sabres, Montreal Canadiens, Tampa Bay Lightning, Pittsburgh Penguins, Ottawa Senators and Boston Bruins ... Colorado Avalanche, Dallas Stars, Minnesota Wild, Utah Mammoth, Edmonton Oilers and Vegas Golden Knights'; R3: 'The following teams have qualified for the playoffs, as of April 13, 2026: Buffalo Sabres ... Tampa Bay Lightning Montreal Canadiens ... Carolina Hurricanes ... Pittsburgh Penguins ... Boston Bruins ... Ottawa Senators Colorado Avalanche ... Dallas Stars Minnesota Wild ... Vegas Golden Knights Edmonton Oilers ... Utah Mammoth'
verifications.reasoning: R1 lists exactly these 13 teams as clinched as of April 13, 2026; R3 confirms these among qualified as of that date; 'including' allows for precision match.
